exposure: customized fetal body mass index (BMI) model
cohort: The study included 9499 subjects to develop and evaluate a new model for prenatal assessment of fetal body mass index and its efficacy in predicting neonatal nutritional status.
finding: The new customized fetal BMI curve demonstrated a superior diagnostic capacity for alterations in fetal and neonatal nutritional status compared to the previously used fetal weight percentile curves (IG21st and GROW).
